title: Pooling from .csv
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Create pooling CSV file
steps.instruction: Generate a CSV that defines custom sample pooling from a source PCR plate into a 1.5 ml, 2 ml, or 5 ml Eppendorf tube; include a header line, list each source plate well and the volume to transfer in microliters, ignore any empty lines, and note that the appropriate pipette will be auto‑selected and tips will be changed for each transfer. Download the example CSV from the provided link if needed.

substeps.instruction: Use the format: "source plate well,volume sample (µl)" as the header.
Enter rows such as "A1, 28" and "C4, 12" for well locations and volumes.
Leave empty lines out of the file; they will be ignored.
Select target tube size (1.5 ml, 2 ml, or 5 ml) as required.
The protocol will automatically choose P10 or P50 GEN1 pipettes based on volume.
A new tip will be used for each transfer.
Download the example CSV via the provided URL to edit directly.

steps.title: Input CSV and mount pipettes
steps.instruction: Load the normalization CSV file into the Opentrons app and specify the mount sides for the P10 and P50 GEN1 single‑channel pipettes.

substeps.instruction: Select the CSV file you created in the previous step.
Enter the deck mount side (left or right) for the P10 pipette.
Enter the deck mount side (left or right) for the P50 GEN1 pipette.

steps.title: Download generated protocol
steps.instruction: Click the "Download" button in the Opentrons app to obtain the Python protocol file.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons app, use the "Upload" function to load the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Arrange deck per map
steps.instruction: Place labware on the robot deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipettes using the OT App, following the standard calibration workflow and consulting the support articles for tip‑calibration guidance.

substeps.instruction: Select each piece of labware on the deck and run its calibration routine.
Calibrate the tip rack(s) for the P10 and P50 GEN1 pipettes.
Calibrate each pipette (P10 and P50 GEN1) to ensure accurate volume delivery.

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: Press the "Run" button in the OT App to start the pooling protocol.
